section.entry:
# todo-cli
A tiny command-line to-do list manager.
## Usage
python app.py
Tasks are stored in `~/.todo.json`.
## Notes
There is no locking, so two concurrent writers will clobber each other. That is fine for a single-user CLI and explicitly out of scope.
# Changelog
- 0.4.2 fix done flag on imported tasks
